power.method: Power over coax from VP controller (SPV-401/801), DC 33V

features: VP model: power and video over one coax cable (SPV-401/801 VP controller)
3.2-10mm (3.1x) motorized varifocal lens, DC auto iris
BNC output: AHD 2M, AHD 4M, TVI 2M selectable
Motion detection (4), privacy masking (16 box / 8 polygon)
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision Japanese user manual (Manuals_HCD-7080RVP,HCV-7080RVP,HCO-7080RVP_240103_JA.pdf, translated), HCO-7080RVP column. 5MP sensor with 2560x1440 max output. Field-of-view lines are unlabelled in the manual; the first (widest-ratio) line is recorded as horizontal. B/W min. illumination is stated only as 0 Lux (IR LED on), so it is not recorded. Powered over coax by a VP controller (SPV-401/801) at DC 33V.
